info.title: Vistoo Work API
info.description:
Versioned HTTP API for native clients. Generated from packages/contracts — do not edit by hand.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>`. Identity comes from the verified token;
workspace membership and role are re-checked on every request.

Clients identify themselves with `X-Vistoo-Client: ios/<build number>`.
Instants are ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds; calendar days are YYYY-MM-DD.
Nullable fields are always present. Enums are open: clients must tolerate unknown values.
See docs/api/README.md for errors, pagination, retries and compatibility rules.

get.summary: Short-lived (60 s) download URL after a fresh access check.
get.description: Download only on explicit user action; do not prefetch.

post.summary: Send a one-time code and magic link to an e-mail address.
post.description: Same rule as the web login: no public sign-up; invited-but-unconfirmed addresses get their invitation again. The response is identical for known and unknown addresses. Verify the code with Supabase Auth (verifyOTP).

get.summary: Everything the app shell needs after sign-in: viewer, projects, people, limits.
Admin: chat file storage usage of the workspace.
Conversations visible to the caller (open channels, own private channels and DMs) with unread state.
Conversation details incl. participants and permissions.

patch.summary: Rename a channel / change its description (responsible person or admins).

put.summary: Archive or restore a channel ("Allgemein" cannot be archived).

post.summary: Private channels: add members (they see the full history).
Private channels: remove a member or leave (responsible person must hand over or archive).

get.summary: Messages, ascending by seq. Cursor pagination.
get.description: No cursor: newest page. `beforeSeq`: older page (scrolling up). `afterSeq`: everything newer (resync after reconnect; bounded, `hasMore` = call again with the last seq).

put.summary: Send a message with a client-generated id (idempotent).
put.description: Repeating the request with the same id returns the stored message instead of a duplicate.

put.summary: Move the own read position forward (never backwards, never beyond the latest message).

post.summary: Reserve an attachment upload (type, size and workspace budget are checked).
post.description: Then PUT the bytes to `signedUrl` (headers: content-type, x-upsert: false) and call finalizeUpload. Reservations expire after 15 minutes; unsent uploads after 24 hours.

post.summary: Create an open or private channel.
Open (or create exactly once) the DM with another member.

put.summary: Register this device's APNs token for push notifications (moves it after an account switch).

delete.summary: Stop pushes to this device (sign-out). Works without membership.
Delete a group; its tasks are kept without group.

post.summary: Admin: invite an e-mail address (sends the invitation e-mail).
Admin: send the invitation again (renews the 7-day validity).
Accept the invitation addressed to the signed-in e-mail.

get.summary: The signed-in user and their access state (works without membership).
Which events send a push to me.

patch.summary: Change notification settings (omitted fields stay unchanged).

delete.summary: Admin: remove a member (access ends immediately; tasks stay, assignments are cleared).

put.summary: Admin: change a member's role (the last admin cannot be demoted).

get.summary: One message with attachments and author (used after realtime events).

delete.summary: Delete an own message (placeholder remains, attachments are removed).

get.summary: All projects (incl. archived, flagged) with groups and task statistics.

patch.summary: Edit name, description and colour (not for archived projects).

post.summary: Add a group to a project.

patch.summary: Change URL and display name of a task link (last write wins).

delete.summary: Remove a link from its task.

get.summary: Tasks of all active projects, or of one project (archived allowed, read-only).
get.description: Not paginated: bounded by the workspace. Ordered by board position.

post.summary: Create a task (appended to the end of its status column).
post.description: Send a client-generated `id` to make retries idempotent.

get.summary: One task (e.g. deep link to a task of an archived project).

patch.summary: Edit a task with optimistic concurrency.
patch.description: Applies only if the stored version equals `expectedVersion`. Otherwise CONFLICT with `error.current`. After a network failure, a CONFLICT whose `current` already contains the intended values means the first attempt succeeded.

put.summary: Quick action: set or clear the responsible person.

get.summary: External links attached to a task (oldest first). Also for tasks of archived projects.

post.summary: Attach an external http(s) link to a task, with an optional display name.
post.description: The URL is validated and stored in canonical form (scheme-less input gets https://). Send a client-generated `id` to make retries idempotent.

post.summary: Board: move a task to a status, between two visible neighbours.
post.description: `afterId` ends up directly above, `beforeId` directly below (null = top/bottom). Hidden tasks keep their positions.

put.summary: Quick action: set the status (task goes to the end of the column; no-op if unchanged).

get.summary: Active members and pending invitations (same visibility as the web; managing them is admin-only).

post.summary: Verify the uploaded bytes (size, file signature) and make the file attachable.

put.summary: Admin: set or clear the workspace meeting link (e.g. a Discord voice channel).

supabaseUrl.description: Clients use exactly this Supabase project for Auth/Realtime.

minimumIosBuild.description: Older iOS builds get CLIENT_OUTDATED and must update.

meetingUrl.description: Join link for team meetings (Discord voice channel). Null until an admin sets it.
